about: Thalmor patrols (#1390, docs/systems/thalmor.md). Staff settings, naming nobody.
on: whether any patrol is out at all. Off until staff turn it on.
most: the most roads with a patrol in the province at once (the page says 3).
stageMost: a cap for a world stage, by its id in war-stages.json, e.g. {"peace": 1}. With no stage, or none for the current one, most holds.
returnMinutes: how long a dead member takes to come back at its point. leash: how far one strays from its point.
tier: the difficulty tier the members fight at, or null for none.
roads: one patrol each. A road is refused if it is not in Tamriel, has fewer than 2 or more than 4 points, or a point is near a walled town.
Each point is one member, made from the base at the same place in bases. A road may set its own returnMinutes and leash.

After a change, run node scripts/dev/Build-StaffData.js, which carries this file inside gamemode.js (the server has no game/data beside it, #2873), commit both and deploy the gamemode. It takes effect at the next start or gamemode reload. A road turned off loses its members then.
